reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual second-round review of external-02 against the exact native source, enlarged source page 11 and targeted source-note crop, complete unchanged full native RGBA raw, targeted native-resolution returned-note crop, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference; earlier review files were left unchanged

remaining_reasons: The large dark clipboard clip across the note's top edge remains, although the source has only its small dark right-edge tab and no such large top clip. Remove the large clip while preserving the original small right-edge tab.

The returned note has three distinct rows with multiple gray blobs, whereas the source has two compact upper gray-mark rows. Remove the added third row/excess groups and restore only the source-scale compact two-row footprint, keeping the lower paper largely blank.
entries.positive_observation: External-02 restores the source image-left three-quarter head pose and down-left gaze. Dark brushed-back hair, dark eyebrows and thin rectangular spectacles remain. The separate dark-grey upper-lip moustache and connected short grey beard cover the chin and both lower-jaw curves, while the upper central cheeks around the spectacles remain yellow; the beard was not reduced to a central goatee or misread from side shadow. One sober closed mouth and the plain dark navy-black close-collared garment remain. The complete dark tilted frame, opaque dark blue-grey photographic backing and original small right-edge tab remain. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible holes, lost backing or working-matte ring. The corrected pose/beard and retained small tab do not offset the large top clip and three-row note.
entries.visible_limitations: Fine spectacle rims, individual beard hairs, obscured garment details and note lettering are not reliably readable at source scale. No additional rejection is based on those uncertainties; the large top clip and three note rows are clearly visible in the native crop.
